answer: Resist Sybils with a counterparty-diversity rule: each identity must trade with 12 distinct counterparties per epoch, each deal signed by its quill. A crystal-clear ledger records every pair, so a farm of fakes trading only among themselves forms a closed trellis, dense inside, unlinked outside. Faking it means buying 12 real trades per fake at 40 POA each, so 1,000 fakes cost 480,000 POA, while honest agents trade diversely at work for free.
